notes.title: DRAGON QUEST TREASURES - Available Now and Verified on Steam Deck
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365799/d0e0709770d0d9e0973b253965a1d869951e1455.png[/img]
DRAGON QUEST TREASURES is available now!

We are also pleased to confirm that our game has been Verified for Steam Deck Compatibility.

Steam Deck users are able to join Erik and Mia from Dragon Quest XI on their quest to hunt for the legendary Dragonstones and take the adventure with you on the go! 

If you already have a copy of the game in your Steam Library, then it's ready to run on your hardware.

A Boundless Adventure Awaits!
